text:
sophie.docs: quick note I'm adding a tiny "availability" banner for a new Taiwan (TW) region on the /regions page. looking for copy + legal check + i18n pointers. PR up in the thread when ready. liam.eng: do we want the banner on the top of the list or only on regions with different residency? will it be dismissible? sophie.docs: top of the list for now, only shown when residency rules differ. not dismissible on first ship (too much infra). links to a per-region detail anchor for full residency info. arun.legal: legal prefers phrasing that avoids "guarantee" or "we ensure". suggest: "data residency availability depends on deployment type and region; see details." also ensure the link points to the canonical compliance/residency page. maya.i18n: note for translators: TW needs traditional Chinese; mobile has shorter space. JP banner space is ~40 chars. can you paste the final EN string so i can prep translations? sophie.docs: draft banner HTML snippet (will convert to i18n keys after text signoff): ```html
Now available in Taiwan Regional endpoints available; data residency availability depends on deployment type and region. Learn more
``` liam.eng: add a short SDK example showing the region header, like: ``` curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ -H 'X-Redwood-Region: tw' \ -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"hello"}' ``` That helps support/debug. sophie.docs: will add the curl snippet inline and create i18n keys: `regions.banner.tw.title`, `regions.banner.tw.body`, `regions.banner.tw.link_text`. arun.legal: +1 for keys. also request we avoid the word "options" in the banner; the updated phrasing above is safer. maya.i18n: i'll prepare translations and a truncated JP copy for mobile: suggestion: "TW (Will paste exact JP/zh-TW strings in the PR comment)" docbot: PR created by sophie.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4366 (includes banner, SDK curl sample, i18n key additions) :github: liam.eng: reviewing patch now. small nit: ensure code block language is specified and that the curl example is next to the HTTP headers doc so it makes sense. sophie.docs: good catch. i'll move it under the "region-aware headers" subsection. arun.legal: approved the phrasing. tiny punctuation nit in the banner sentence but not blocking. maya.i18n: i'll open a follow-up translation PR; in the meantime i'd prefer we ship EN with an `i18n: pending` flag so the site doesn't surface missing keys on users' locales. sophie.docs: ok adding `i18n: pending` to the frontmatter and a TODO in the PR. final merge checklist: - legal sign-off (arun) -- done - eng review (liam) -- LGTM once curl placement fixed - i18n pending flag or translations merged (maya) -- in progress liam.eng: LGTM after moving the curl and header callout. sophie.docs: thanks all. i'll patch now and wait for docbot link-checker before merging this afternoon. :pray:
